Hi Ben - re ROUTEKIT-121: the agreed decision was that if the network lists the same depot pair more than once (either orientation), those are physically separate roads (e.g. old road + new bypass), so closing one leaves the other open and such a pair is never critical. Full context is in notes/omar/handover.md under 'critical_roads'.
